description: This file contains the PHP class definition for the Wishlist model within the OpenCart system, specifically in the Catalog module under the Account namespace. It provides methods to add, delete, retrieve, and count wishlist items for a customer.

classes.name: Wishlist
classes.description: Represents the wishlist functionality for customer accounts, including methods for managing wishlist items.

methods.name: addWishlist
methods.description: Adds a product to a customer's wishlist, deleting duplicates if they exist.

methods.name: deleteWishlist
methods.description: Removes a product from a customer's wishlist, optionally for a specific product ID.

methods.name: getWishlist
methods.description: Retrieves the list of wishlist items for a specific customer.

methods.name: getTotalWishlist
methods.description: Counts the total number of wishlist items for a specific customer.
